meta.title: Paid subscription: API write to balanced ledger

messages.label: POST /v1/subscriptions + Idempotency-Key
messages.note: plan_id, publication_id, amount_cents 500; key at least 16 chars

messages.label: claim idempotency_keys (user_id, key)
messages.note: known key: same hash replays the stored response (Idempotency-Replayed: true); different hash -> 422

messages.label: INSERT subscriptions + outbox subscription.created
messages.note: bill computed once: author 450, platform 50, tax 40, total 540; envelope carries correlation_id

messages.label: SELECT pending FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
messages.note: batch 25; competing pollers never claim the same row

messages.label: PutEvents(envelope)
messages.note: publish-then-mark; failure -> status failed, backoff 5 s x 2^(n-1), terminal after 10

messages.label: claim event_processing_attempts, lease 300 s
messages.note: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; succeeded -> duplicate (delete), started with live lease -> leave for SQS retry

messages.label: validate subscription row FOR UPDATE
messages.note: charged_amount_cents and currency must match the event bill; mismatch is a SourceConflictError

messages.label: PUT receipt JSON, IfNoneMatch *
messages.note: write-once; an identical existing object is accepted, different bytes fail

messages.label: ledger_transactions + 3 ledger_entries + stats + outbox ledger.transaction.recorded + attempt succeeded
messages.note: one transaction; UNIQUE(source_type, source_id) blocks a second ledger write on any replay

messages.label: DeleteMessage
messages.note: on handler failure nothing is deleted; attempt_number >= 5 emits event.processing.failed and SQS redrives to the DLQ

cards.title: Two idempotency layers
items: A duplicate click stops at the API: same key + same body replays the stored 201.
A duplicate SQS delivery stops at the worker: the attempt row already succeeded or holds a live lease.

cards.title: Crash between receipt and commit
items: The lease expires, a later delivery reclaims the event, the receipt PUT is idempotent, and the ledger UNIQUE constraint prevents a double charge.
S3 and PostgreSQL are never made atomic; the lease is the recovery mechanism.

cards.title: What the worker does not do
items: It never recomputes fee or tax from current config; it validates the event's bill and writes it.
It never mutates the source row on failure; failed attempts stay visible for the admin runbook.
